server.networkTitle: See how other devices reach this one

app.profileInUse: TropicalPeer is already open with this profile. Close the other copy, then open it again.

peers.title: Peers
peers.subtitle: Click a device to choose files, or drag files from Explorer onto it.
peers.subtitleMac: Click a device to choose files, or drag files from Finder onto it.
peers.subtitleTouch: Tap a device to choose files to send it.
peers.dropHint: Drop the files on the device that should get them.
peers.emptyBody: Open TropicalPeer on the other device too. One of you shows a short code like {code}, the other types it in. After that you can send files to each other anytime, from anywhere.
peers.dropOnPeer: Drop the files onto a peer to send them.
peers.pairFirstToDrop: Pair with a device first, then drop files on it.

peer.removedUsToast: {name} removed this device. Pair again to send files to it.
peer.removeBody: {name} won't be able to send you files anymore, and you won't be able to send to it. You can pair again later with a new code.

peerSettings.title: Peer settings
peerSettings.name: Name
peerSettings.askDesc: You choose to accept or decline each time.
peerSettings.autoDesc: Files are saved right away. Best for your own devices.
peerSettings.blockDesc: Everything is declined. The peer is not told why.
peerSettings.saveTo: Save files from this peer to
peerSettings.limitError: Enter a size limit above zero, or turn the limit off.

pair.title: Add a peer
pair.askNote: You'll be asked before files from {name} are saved. You can switch it to auto-accept later.
pair.enterThis: Enter this code on the other device
pair.typeCode: Type the code shown on the other device
pair.expired: The code expired before anyone used it.
pair.mismatch: The code didn't match. Check it and try again with a new code.
pair.unknownCode: That code doesn't exist or has expired. Ask for a new one.
pair.ownCode: That's this device's own code. Enter it on the other device.
pair.noServer: Can't reach the rendezvous server. Check Settings.

offer.label: {name} wants to send you files
offer.timedOut: You didn't answer {name} in time, so the files were declined.
offer.gone: This offer is no longer available.

links.title: Links
links.subtitle: Share files with anyone through a link or QR code. They download them in a browser, straight from this device. No app needed.
links.anyoneOff: Off: only the first person who opens it can download.
links.anyoneOn: On: everyone who has the link can download until you stop it.
links.waitingForSomeone: Waiting for someone to open it. Keep TropicalPeer open.
links.visitorWaiting: Opened the link; hasn't pressed Download yet
links.visitorRefused: Turned away: the link was for one person only
links.visitorFailed: Lost the connection to their browser
links.qrLabel: QR code for the link to {what}
links.emptyBody: Choose New link, or drop files here. Anyone who scans the code or opens the link can download them in a browser while TropicalPeer stays open.
links.dropHint: Drop to make a link for these files
links.unsupportedTitle: Your server doesn't do links yet
links.unsupportedBody: Links need a rendezvous server with a web address (HTTPS). Update the server and start it with -domain; the README explains how.
links.offlineBody: Links go through your rendezvous server. Once this device is connected, you can make them here.
links.notReady: TropicalPeer is still starting. Try again in a moment.
links.unsupported: Your rendezvous server doesn't support links.
links.endedServer: This link stopped working because your server couldn't be reached for 15 minutes. Make a new one.
links.reconnecting: Reconnecting to your server… Downloads already running carry on.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.subtitle: Files sent and received since TropicalPeer opened.
transfers.emptyBody: Drag files onto a device on the Peers page, or click it to choose files. Files that others send you show up here too.
transfers.emptyBodyTouch: Tap a device on the Peers page to choose files for it. Files that others send you show up here too.

transfer.directTip: This transfer started on the relay, found a direct path partway through, and moved the rest onto it.
transfer.relayedTip: These devices couldn't reach each other directly, so the files travel through your rendezvous server. They stay end-to-end encrypted; relayed transfers are just slower.
transfer.resumeAskFailed: Couldn't reach {name} to resume. TropicalPeer needs to be open there.
transfer.resumeGone: {name} can't resume this anymore. Ask them to send it again.
transfer.offline: {name} is offline. Make sure TropicalPeer is open on it.
transfer.willResume: Connection lost. It continues where it left off when {name} reconnects.
transfer.timedOutConn: The connection timed out. The other device may be on a network that blocks incoming connections.
transfer.noRelay: Couldn't reach the other device directly, and your server doesn't relay. Ask whoever runs it to enable relaying, or forward UDP port 7778 on one side.
transfer.unreachable: Couldn't connect to the other device. Check that both of you can reach the rendezvous server.
transfer.noServer: Can't reach the rendezvous server. Check Settings.
transfer.tooManyFiles: That's more than {count} files. Send fewer at a time, or zip them.
transfer.peerNeedsUpdate: The other device can't take this many files at once. Update TropicalPeer there, or send fewer files.
transfer.listTooLong: The list of files is too long to send in one go. Send fewer at a time, or zip them.
transfer.removedYou: {name} removed this device, so it won't take files from you. Pair again to send.
transfer.onlySent: Only sent transfers can be retried.
transfer.fileGone: That file isn't there anymore; it may have been moved or deleted.
transfer.folderMissing: That folder doesn't exist yet; it's created when the first file arrives.

share.pairFirst: Pair with a device first; the files wait here until you do.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How this device shows up and connects.
settings.restartPort: Restart TropicalPeer to start using the new port.
settings.deviceNameHint: Shown to devices you pair with.
settings.deviceNameDetail: Devices you've already paired with keep any nickname they gave this one.
settings.readyHint: Receive files even when TropicalPeer isn't open.
settings.readyDetail: Android only lets an app stay online in the background while it shows a notification, so a quiet one stays while this is on. Offers then arrive as notifications you can accept or decline. Uses a little more battery.
settings.readyOff: Off: files arrive only while the app is open
settings.readyNotifNote: Offers can't reach you outside the app until notifications are allowed.
settings.downloadDetail: A peer can have its own folder instead: choose Peer settings from its ⋯ menu.
settings.downloadDetailPhone: Your Files and Gallery apps find them there.
settings.chooseDownload: Choose where received files are saved
settings.serverHint: Introduces your devices to each other.
settings.serverDetail: Files go straight between devices. Only when two devices can't reach each other does the server relay them, still end-to-end encrypted, so it can't read them.
settings.forwardingHint: Helps devices on other networks connect directly.
settings.forwardingDetail: TropicalPeer asks your router to open its port (using UPnP or NAT-PMP), which makes direct connections work even behind a strict router. The opening is removed when TropicalPeer closes.
settings.forwardingAsk: Ask my router to forward a port
settings.seeReachable: See how this device is reachable
settings.listenHint: The port this device receives on. Applies after a restart.
settings.listenDetail: A UDP port. If automatic forwarding isn't available, forwarding this port to this device on your router lets devices outside your network connect directly. 0 picks a free port.
settings.errHost: Enter a server host name or IP address.
settings.errServerPort: The server port must be between 1 and 65535.
settings.errListenPort: The listening port must be between 0 and 65535 (0 = random).
settings.errLimitNegative: The size limit can't be negative.
settings.errFolderPath: Choose a full folder path, like C:\Users\you\Downloads.
settings.restartHint: Reconnects and applies settings that need a restart.
settings.restartDetail: Use it after changing the listening port, or if connections seem stuck. The app stays open; transfers in progress stop and can be retried.
settings.versionHint: Which build of TropicalPeer this device runs. Mention it when reporting a problem.
settings.portPending: Switches to UDP {port} after a restart.

restartConfirmBody.one: {count} transfer in progress will stop. You can retry it afterwards.
restartConfirmBody.other: {count} transfers in progress will stop. You can retry them afterwards.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: How other devices reach this one. {checked}
network.vOfflineBody: Pairing and sending need it. Check your internet connection and the server address in Settings.
network.vDirectTitle: Other devices can reach this one directly
network.vDirectBody: Transfers go straight between devices, as fast as both connections allow.
network.vMostTitle: Most devices can reach this one directly
network.vMostBody: A device behind a very strict router may need the relay.
network.vRelayTitle: Transfers from other networks will use the relay
network.vRelayBody: Your router doesn't allow direct connections. Files stay end-to-end encrypted; they're just slower. Forwarding UDP port {port} to this device on your router fixes this.
network.vBlockedTitle: Devices on other networks can't reach this one
network.vBlockedBody: Your router doesn't allow direct connections and your server doesn't relay. Forward UDP port {port} to this device on your router, or use a server that relays.
network.vSoonBody: Your router type will show up in a moment.
network.vNoDetectBody: Your server can't tell what kind of router you have, so it's unclear whether devices can reach this one directly.
network.serverHint: Introduces your devices to each other. Your files never pass through it unless it relays.
network.publicHint: What the internet sees. It changes when your network does.
network.lastKnown: Last known; it can't be checked without the server.
network.routerHint: Decides whether devices outside your network can reach this one directly.
network.openNote: Lets other devices in once this one has reached out to them.
network.restrictedNote: Lets in only the exact addresses this device has contacted. Works with most devices.
network.strictNote: Uses a different public address for every destination, so other devices can't aim at this one.
network.checkingRouter: Asking the server how your router behaves.
network.noDetect: Your server can't tell what kind of router you have.
network.forwardingHint: Asks your router to let other devices in, whatever its type.
network.fActiveNote: Your router forwards {addr} to this device until TropicalPeer closes.
network.fByHand: Forward UDP {port} by hand: see Listening port
network.problemCgnat: Your router is itself behind your internet provider's shared connection, so forwarding a port on it can't help.
network.problemNone: Your router doesn't offer automatic port forwarding, or has it switched off.
network.problemRefused: Your router didn't accept the request to forward a port.
network.relayHint: The fallback when two devices can't connect directly.
network.relayAvailableNote: Used only when a direct path fails. Transfers switch to a direct path on their own if one opens later.
network.relayOffNote: Devices that can't connect directly won't be able to send to each other.
network.relayUnknownNote: Depends on the server; known once it's reachable again.
network.serverError: Can't reach the rendezvous server. Check the address in Settings and that the server is running.

android.fileGone: That file isn't in Downloads anymore. It may have been moved or deleted.
android.noViewer: No app on this phone can open that file.
android.openFilesApp: Open the Files app and look in Downloads/TropicalPeer.
android.chOffersDesc: A paired device wants to send you files.
android.chActiveDesc: Progress while files move, and the quiet notice while TropicalPeer stays ready to receive.
android.chReceivedDesc: Files that arrived while TropicalPeer wasn't open.
android.readyText: Paired devices can send you files.
android.folderFailed: Couldn't use that folder. Choose another one.

update.title: Updates
update.hint: Get new versions of TropicalPeer as they come out.
update.restartSoon: TropicalPeer {version} is ready. Restarting in {s} seconds.
update.installSoon: TropicalPeer {version} is ready. Installing in {s} seconds.
update.unsigned: The new version isn't signed, so it wasn't installed.
update.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check the internet connection.
update.moveToApplications: To get updates, move TropicalPeer to the Applications folder and open it from there.
update.folderReadOnly: TropicalPeer can't update itself in this folder. Move it to a folder you can change, then open it from there.
update.notReady: There's no update ready to install.
